observed.action: The man stands on a concrete platform facing the water, then raises his right hand to his head and rubs his scalp before lowering his arm and standing still.
observed.camera: A static, medium-long shot from behind and slightly to the side of the man.
observed.clothing: A cream long-sleeved shirt with a small red star on the back, dark suspenders, brown-and-white checkered trousers, and black shoes.
observed.identity: A man with a slim build, seen mostly from behind, with a short beard visible when he turns his head.
observed.scene: A sunlit concrete pier or dock beside a calm body of water, with weathered wooden posts in the water to the left and a clear blue sky.
